_description: Employment savings only — no spending, no growth, no tax. Verifies employment_savings flows as after_tax income and respects start/end ages.
_rationale: 100k initial savings, 50k/yr employment_savings ages 55–64 (10 years). 0% return, no spending. Balance grows linearly: 100k + 50k*n. At age 64 (last year active), balance = 100k + 50k*10 = 600k. Ages 65+ balance stays flat at 600k. Success 100%.
name: Employment Savings Basic
